logline: Rin Okumura discovers he is the son of Satan and enrolls at True Cross Academy's exorcist cram school, determined to master his demonic powers and kill his own father before either world is destroyed.

renewal.note: Season 4 (The Blue Night Saga) concluded in March 2025 with the manga source continuing. A fifth season has not been formally confirmed as of June 2026.

bollymeter.basis: IMDb rating of 7.4 from the 2011 series reflects consistent audience approval for A-1 Pictures' kinetic adaptation, though the anime-original ending in the final third divided fans of the source manga.

seasons.review_body: Blue Exorcist Season 1 aired in 2011 on MBS/TBS and was simulcast internationally via ANN, establishing the franchise as one of the decade's reliable shonen supernatural titles. A-1 Pictures delivered confident production - the demon-world design and Rin's blue-flame power set had visual personality - while the first 17 episodes faithfully adapted Kazue Kato's manga. The final eight episodes departed into anime-original territory that divided the existing fanbase and prompted the 2017 Kyoto Saga to restart from the manga. MAL's approximate 7.48 score and IMDb's 7.4 reflect strong overall reception despite the tonal inconsistency of the anime-original ending in the final eight episodes. The series simulcast via ANN made it one of the first major shonen titles to reach global streaming audiences in near-real-time.

episode_reviews.title: The Demon Boy
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere introduces Rin as a volatile teenager whose latent demonic power erupts in a confrontation with a Demon Familiar, forcing the secret of his parentage into the open. A-1 Pictures establishes the blue-flame visual identity that defines the franchise.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Rin's blue flames emerge for the first time - the visual that became the franchise's signature across four seasons.

bollymeter.basis: IMDb rating of 7.3 for the Kyoto Saga reflects audience appreciation for the manga-faithful restart, though the shorter episode count and slower Kyoto arc pacing prevented it from matching Season 1's energy.

seasons.review_body: The Kyoto Saga (Season 2) premiered in January 2017 after a six-year gap, resetting the timeline to follow the manga faithfully from where Season 1 diverged. Produced by A-1 Pictures across 13 episodes, it adapts the Impure King arc set in Kyoto, deepening Rin's relationships with his Cram School classmates and expanding the mythology of the Order of the True Cross. IMDb's 7.3 score tracks with a solid adaptation of a compelling manga arc, though viewers arriving from Season 1's anime-original cliffhanger faced a continuity adjustment. The season adapts the manga arc the original ending bypassed, making it the more faithful telling of the Kyoto material.
seasons.season_over_season: The Kyoto Saga jettisons Season 1's anime-original ending and delivers a more faithful, more measured adaptation - a reset that rewards manga readers more than anime-first viewers.

bollymeter.basis: IMDb rating of 6.9 for the Shimane Illuminati Saga reflects audience consensus that the arc's pacing and antagonist development were weaker entries in the long-running franchise.

seasons.review_body: The Shimane Illuminati Saga (Season 3) aired in early 2024 under the new production banner Studio VOLN, continuing the manga adaptation with a 12-episode run focused on the Illuminati faction's threat and Rin's growing command of his demonic heritage. The production change from A-1 Pictures to Studio VOLN brought a slightly different visual texture. IMDb's 6.9 rating - the franchise's lowest - reflects audience response to an arc that served primarily as setup for the stronger Blue Night Saga that followed.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 3 is largely connective tissue for the stronger Blue Night Saga, and its 6.9 IMDb score reflects that transitional nature.

bollymeter.basis: IMDb rating of 7.8 for The Blue Night Saga - the franchise's highest-rated season - reflects critical and audience consensus that the two-cour run finally delivers on the mythology seeds planted across three prior seasons.

seasons.review_body: The Blue Night Saga (Season 4) ran for 24 episodes across two cours from October 2024 to March 2025, representing the most ambitious production the franchise had undertaken since the original 2011 series. Studio VOLN deepened its visual command of the material, and the arc's central conflict around Rin's parentage and the Blue Night massacre delivered the mythology payoff long-time viewers had been waiting for. The 7.8 IMDb score is the highest of any Blue Exorcist season, suggesting the investment in the franchise's continuity across thirteen years finally compounded into something genuinely satisfying for the audience that stayed the course.
seasons.season_over_season: The Blue Night Saga is the franchise's peak - a 24-episode run that finally cashes the cheques written by three prior seasons of mythology building.
